name: Kuro
source:
The roommate of Shiro. She has yet to see many humans and is curious about the protagonist. Also, she is a NEET and always stays home. Although she is in charge of household chores, she is not very good at it.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/the-hidden-village-of-witches-and-catgirls/]Kagura Games[/url]]
